body:
Okay, so this is mainly for MapDevs only!

Me and Zedther had made a map, for the TDM Tournament, it wasn't put in to the that tournament rotation, but it was accepted. 

I have gone through all map releases post, all of mine and Zedthers post's, and I still can't find it.

I don't quite remember anything, besides the fact it was TDM.

(I needed to keep this private, sorry! This is the last thing I need before I go! 

Regards, Dawson!
